source.license_review: API documentation: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 in api/README.md; reference input only, E7 generation/distribution unresolved.

license_policy: Pinned CC BY-NC-SA API documentation is verification-only input. The distributed coverage report records operation identifiers and authored support classifications only; it copies no descriptions or schemas.

unsupported_policy.reason: The operation is not in the generated overlay and has no separately reviewed high-level implementation.
unsupported_policy.runtime_behavior: NativeAPI rejects its operationId before opening a network session; arbitrary URL escape hatches are not provided.
unsupported_policy.promotion: Add exact structural facts to the authored overlay or high-level coverage manifest, tests, documentation and real-provider evidence before claiming support.

ambiguous_policy.reason: More than one pinned endpoint declares the same operationId, so selection by identifier alone is ambiguous.
ambiguous_policy.promotion: Resolve with an authored exact source/method/path selection and a distinct runtime name; never choose the first candidate implicitly.
